workflow_rationale: The task adds three user-facing deliverables (README rewrite, first-run wizard, tooltips) on top of an existing Next.js frontend. These can be implemented in sequential frontend phases with an integration phase at the end.

phases.description: Replace the generic Next.js README with ProCal-specific installation and IEC-calculation documentation.

subtasks.description: Rewrite README.md with ProCal overview, installation steps, tech stack, and IEC calculation assumptions

verification.instructions: Open README.md and confirm it explains ProCal, installation (npm install + env + prisma migrate), and IEC assumptions (voltage drop limits, demand factors, cable sizing method, country defaults).

subtasks.notes: Implemented wizard step actions in OnboardingWizard.tsx. The wizard now creates a sample project via /api/projects, a building via /api/buildings, an apartment template via /api/templates, and a first-floor apartment item via /api/floors/{id}/items. Added per-step forms synchronized to state, loading states, error handling, and Next/Back validation. Verified with npx tsc --noEmit, eslint, next build, and the vitest suite (141 tests passed). Browser E2E verification is pending because the available Node.js runtime did not match the compiled better-sqlite3 binary version for direct DB inspection; dev server was booted successfully on localhost:3000.

parallel_groups.reason: These phases touch disjoint file sets (README vs wizard component vs tooltip component) and have no interdependencies.

parallelism.speedup_estimate: 1.5x faster than sequential; phases 1-3 can run concurrently while phase 4 waits for all three.

acceptance_criteria: README explains ProCal, installation, and IEC assumptions
First-run wizard creates a sample project end-to-end
Tooltips appear on key calculation inputs
Existing tests and lint checks still pass
